subject.title: Steer mode does not inject messages mid-turn for main sessions

question: Should #89238, or a refreshed successor, be the canonical path for allowing ordinary same-session visible messages to bypass busy admission and reach active-run queue policy?
rationale: The documented bug is real, but the permanent fix crosses message-delivery ordering, no-visible fallback behavior, and session-state ownership, and the existing candidate is both conflicting and reviewed as semantically incomplete.

options.title: Refresh the admission-layer PR
options.body: Treat #89238 as the canonical path, rebase or replace it on current main, and fix the fallback/session-state semantics before merge.

options.title: Limit steering to explicit controls for now
options.body: Keep ordinary messages queued while documenting command-only steering until maintainers redesign the ordinary-message admission contract.

options.title: Split channel-specific follow-ups
options.body: Keep #48003 canonical for the broad bug and open narrower channel issues only if Telegram, Discord, or WebChat need different ownership.

recommendation.title: Refresh the admission-layer PR
recommendation.body: Treat #89238 as the canonical path, rebase or replace it on current main, and fix the fallback/session-state semantics before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The remaining choice belongs in reply dispatch/admission semantics, where history shows repeated recent ownership and adjacent cleanup.
